title: tessera.audit-policy/1
description: An audit policy (RFC-0016 'Policy'): the recorder's period, the length buckets and their rates, the batch bounds, the proof deadline and the parameter set. `tessera audit sample` reads it strictly: no key may be missing or unknown. It becomes the sample's `AuditPolicy`, each rate its threshold over 2^64.

period_ns.description: The recorder's period, in nanoseconds: a 64-bit unsigned integer.

buckets.description: The length buckets, `max_tokens` strictly increasing. A request of `L` tokens takes the first bucket whose `max_tokens` is at least `L`; a request longer than every bucket is selected whatever the seed.

min_batch_tokens.description: The fewest tokens a batch proves, but for at most one batch of each group (RFC-0016 'Batching').

max_batch_tokens.description: The most tokens a batch proves, but for a request longer than that alone: at least 1 and at least twice `min_batch_tokens`.

proof_deadline_ns.description: The time the prover has to prove the sample once it is fixed, in nanoseconds: a 64-bit unsigned integer.

params.description: The parameter set's identifier, printable ASCII, for example `live-64/1`.

max_tokens.description: The longest request the bucket holds, in total tokens over both directions and both periods (RFC-0063).

rate.description: The rate as a decimal string: `0`, `1`, or `0.` or `1.` followed by one to 19 digits, at most 1. Its threshold is floor(rate * 2^64), capped at 2^64 - 1, computed exactly.
